Urgent disk.smart

The drive Seagate ST2000 has 142 bad spots it has had to stop using. It still works, but this is how a disk begins to fail: back up your files and keep an eye on it.

What this means: The drive has found areas it can no longer use and has moved the data elsewhere. A few is normal ageing; a growing number is the drive wearing out.

What to do:

  • Copy anything you would hate to lose to another drive or a cloud folder. Do this before anything else on this list.
  • Check this again in a week. A count that stays put is ageing; a count that climbs is a drive on its way out.
